unzip -q "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_PATH}" -d ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
mv ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/android-ndk-r${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION:0:2}? ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
echo "ndk.dir=${ANDROID_NDK}" >> local.properties
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetApi=arm64-v8a -PincludeUniversalApk=false -PenableApkSplits=true
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/geotag_camera*arm64-v8a.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
